notes.title: Hear ye, hear ye: Ship Fight is ready for playtesting!
notes.content: [p]I'm still getting a handle on Steam Playtest so bear with me, but you should see a button on the Store Page what lets you sign up to play the game on Windows or Mac.  At this very early point I'm releasing playtesting in limited batches (so if you try to play and it tells you to wait, email me at [b]gundlach.business at gmail[/b] and I'll let you in quicker), but open signups will come shortly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I'm looking for feedback[/b] on gameplay, what modes you like or hate, how to improve the levels, what weapon powerups you wish existed on the Pure Deathmatch level, how you want to navigate between levels.  [b]I DON'T need feedback[/b] on art or music, as I'm in the process of replacing those placeholders with something made by someone with actual talent.[/p][p][/p][p]You can email me at [b]gundlach.business at gmail[/b], or better yet, drop in the discord at [url="https://discord.gg/qwAjTmx8hP"][b]https://discord.gg/qwAjTmx8hP[/b][/url] and vent your frustration in #general.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Known bugs:[/b] Capture The Flag's level sucks and everyone hates it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] You can skip a level from the pause menu when you're ready to move on.[/p][p][/p][p]I have already patched to reduce volume, because wow it was too loud.  I hope to soon send out a patch that fixes the roughest edges and the painiest points.  Like, the tutorial needs to be skippable and controls just listed on the huge swathes of black space I'm not using on either side of the arena.  So much to make less bad, so little time.  Onward and upward![/p][p][/p][p]Happy fighting![/p]
